summary: Quaffing the final lit potion of oil reaches the C peffect_oil effect before the potion is consumed. The refusal occurs at generic object deallocation: mkobj.c dealloc_obj() must stop the object's BURN_OBJECT timer, whose cleanup_burn() removes its light source and clears lamplit. The JavaScript quaff path currently reaches inventory preflight without the stopObjectTimers lifecycle hook; preflight also requires deleteObjectLightSource for a lit object. Keep this source scope on the whole dealloc_obj() cleanup branch and its caller wiring, separate from peffect_oil() and the later input boundary.

source.branch: When the final lit POT_OIL item is deallocated with obj->timed nonzero, dealloc_obj() calls obj_stop_timers() before its separate obj_sheds_light() cleanup; the BURN_OBJECT cleanup removes the light and clears lamplit.
callers: shk.c obfree() directly calls mkobj.c dealloc_obj() after billing and worn-object handling.
cmd.c command q dispatches to potion.c dodrink(); dodrink() calls potion.c dopotion(), which calls invent.c useup()/useupall(), then shk.c obfree() reaches mkobj.c dealloc_obj().
dependencies: invent.c useup() and useupall() consume the selected potion.
shk.c obfree() performs ordinary object cleanup and calls dealloc_obj().
timeout.c obj_stop_timers() removes the object timers and invokes their cleanup callbacks.
light.c del_light_source() removes the object light; cleanup_burn() also restores unused oil age, clears lamplit, and updates carried inventory.

evidence: The assigned diagnostic artifact `.cache/synthetic-scans/v15/wizard-quaffs-lit-oil-resist.json` records a stop at step 66 with `stopObjectTimers is not available for otyp 321`; the assigned queue entry records exactly 2 remaining screens of 68. The source owner is not supplied by the queue (sourceFile is null), so the source trace below attributes the refusal.

The assigned C recording `challenges/cases/v15/wizard-quaffs-lit-oil-resist.session.json`, segment 0, steps 65-67, shows `q` opening the drink prompt, `p` quaffing the lit oil, and C step 66 recording `d(2,4)=4 @ peffect_oil(potion.c:1277)` with the message “You burn your face.” Step 67 is the separate following space input, reported by C as `Unknown command`. The effect runs before the consumption cleanup; the later input boundary is not the timer owner.

In `nethack-c/upstream/src/potion.c:617-640`, dodrink() calls dopotion(); dopotion() calls peffects(), then after a negative result reaches useup(). `potion.c:1411-1413` dispatches POT_OIL to peffect_oil(), and `potion.c:1262-1293` handles the lit branch (damage, slime cleanup, Wisdom exercise) without deleting the potion or stopping its timer. This separates the recorded effect RNG from the subsequent refusal.

In `nethack-c/upstream/src/invent.c:1310-1332`, useup() routes a one-item stack through useupall(), which calls shk.c obfree() at `invent.c:1316`. `shk.c:1187-1274` finishes ordinary object cleanup by calling dealloc_obj().

The complete C owner is `nethack-c/upstream/src/mkobj.c:2745-2795`, dealloc_obj(): after validating a detached object, it calls obj_stop_timers() when obj->timed is nonzero (`2765-2767`), then handles any remaining light source (`2777-2780`) before releasing the object. This is the whole-function scope for the source-owned cleanup branch.

`nethack-c/upstream/src/timeout.c:1727-1789` gives POT_OIL a BURN_OBJECT timer when lit. The timeout table maps BURN_OBJECT to cleanup_burn() at `1984`; obj_stop_timers() walks matching object timers, invokes each registered cleanup, then sets obj->timed to zero (`2373-2397`). cleanup_burn() removes the light, restores the unused fuel time, clears lamplit, and refreshes carried inventory (`1824-1844`).

At the examined JavaScript commit, `js/potion.js:1805-1830` ends dopotion() with useup(otmp) without lifecycle hooks. `js/invent.js:3675-3685` preflights stopObjectTimers first and deleteObjectLightSource for a lit object; `js/obj.js:1143-1162` consumes those same hooks in dealloc_obj(). `js/timeout.js:1187-1220` already implements obj_stop_timers() and the BURN_OBJECT cleanup, so the first refusal is missing lifecycle wiring into the existing timer cleanup, not missing peffect_oil() behavior.
